articles.headline: Asian Stocks Steady Amid Easing AI and Mideast Jitters
articles.brief: Asian markets held steady as concerns regarding artificial intelligence and Middle East tensions receded, while the dollar remained firm driven by Federal Reserve rate expectations.

articles.headline: China's Factory-Gate Inflation Hits Multi-Year High
articles.brief: China reported its fastest factory-gate inflation in nearly four and a half years for October, even as consumer price index rises moderated across the country.

articles.headline: Sheikh Hasina Seeks New Passport for Bangladesh Return
articles.brief: Former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has requested a new passport and national identity card ahead of a planned December return, while the government pushes for her extradition.

articles.headline: Trump Meets Qatar PM as Iran Diplomacy Faces Hurdles
articles.brief: US President Donald Trump is set to meet Qatar's prime minister as diplomatic efforts regarding Iran encounter major hurdles and conflicting regional demands.

articles.headline: Iraq Gas Field Production Suspended After Drone Attack
articles.brief: Production at Iraq's Khor Mor gas field has been entirely suspended following a drone attack, according to industry sources close to the operation.

articles.headline: Israel: Netanyahu Rival Eisenkot Seeks Wide Government
articles.brief: Gadi Eisenkot has received a mandate to form a government in Israel after a tight election, though his path to building a stable coalition remains uncertain.

articles.headline: Nvidia Probes CEO Huang Over Affair and Spying Risk
articles.brief: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an extramarital affair, prompting the company's board to initiate an independent security review regarding potential foreign espionage targeting him.

articles.headline: Delhi Air Quality Plunges to Severe Category Post-Diwali
articles.brief: Delhi's air quality index surged above 400 into the severe category after residents defied firecracker bans during Deepavali, spreading thick smog across major neighboring cities.

articles.headline: Anthropic Secures $3.4 Billion Generator Deal for AI Hubs
articles.brief: Anthropic has finalized commitments for 1.7 gigawatts of heavy-duty power generators from OnePWR Solutions to support its rapidly expanding artificial intelligence data center infrastructure.

articles.headline: Hacked Records Reveal 400,000 Russian Casualties in Ukraine
articles.brief: Confidential internal data from Russia's statistics agency Rosstat indicates that approximately 400,000 Russian soldiers have died fighting in the ongoing war against Ukraine.

articles.headline: Rohit Sharma Focuses on Series Win Against New Zealand
articles.brief: India enters the third ODI against New Zealand holding a 2-0 series lead, with captain Shubman Gill and senior batter Rohit Sharma looking to capitalize in bowler-friendly conditions.
